list.query: SELECT name FROM geofences WHERE valid_to IS NULL ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM overflight_events e WHERE 
  e.geofence_id IN (SELECT id FROM geofences WHERE name IN ($zone))
  AND e.category IN ($category)
  AND (e.relevant OR '$relevant' = 'alle')
  AND e.entry_ts >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'

SELECT count(*) AS n FROM overflight_events e WHERE 
  e.geofence_id IN (SELECT id FROM geofences WHERE name IN ($zone))
  AND e.category IN ($category)
  AND (e.relevant OR '$relevant' = 'alle')
  AND e.entry_ts >= now() - interval '7 days'

SELECT count(*) AS n FROM overflight_events e WHERE 
  e.geofence_id IN (SELECT id FROM geofences WHERE name IN ($zone))
  AND e.category IN ($category)
  AND (e.relevant OR '$relevant' = 'alle')
  AND e.entry_ts >= now() - interval '30 days'

SELECT min(e.min_alt_ft) AS ft FROM overflight_events e WHERE $__timeFilter(e.entry_ts) AND 
  e.geofence_id IN (SELECT id FROM geofences WHERE name IN ($zone))
  AND e.category IN ($category)
  AND (e.relevant OR '$relevant' = 'alle')

SELECT 100 * sum(greatest(recorded_s - gap_s, 0)) / nullif(sum(day_s), 0) AS "%"
FROM data_coverage_daily
WHERE day BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz::date AND ($__timeTo())::timestamptz::date

SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS time,
  e.category AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM overflight_events e
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.entry_ts) AND 
  e.geofence_id IN (SELECT id FROM geofences WHERE name IN ($zone))
  AND e.category IN ($category)
  AND (e.relevant OR '$relevant' = 'alle')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (ARRAY['Mo', 'Di', 'Mi', 'Do', 'Fr', 'Sa', 'So'])[extract(isodow FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::int] AS "Tag",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 0) AS "00",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 1) AS "01",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 2) AS "02",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 3) AS "03",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 4) AS "04",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 5) AS "05",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 6) AS "06",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 7) AS "07",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 8) AS "08",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 9) AS "09",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 10) AS "10",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 11) AS "11",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 12) AS "12",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 13) AS "13",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 14) AS "14",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 15) AS "15",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 16) AS "16",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 17) AS "17",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 18) AS "18",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 19) AS "19",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 20) AS "20",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 21) AS "21",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 22) AS "22",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 23) AS "23"
FROM overflight_events e
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.entry_ts) AND 
  e.geofence_id IN (SELECT id FROM geofences WHERE name IN ($zone))
  AND e.category IN ($category)
  AND (e.relevant OR '$relevant' = 'alle')
GROUP BY extract(isodow FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')
ORDER BY extract(isodow FROM e.entry_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')

SELECT to_char(floor(e.min_alt_ft / 1000.0) * 1000, 'FM99990') AS "ab ft", count(*) AS n
FROM overflight_events e
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.entry_ts) AND 
  e.geofence_id IN (SELECT id FROM geofences WHERE name IN ($zone))
  AND e.category IN ($category)
  AND (e.relevant OR '$relevant' = 'alle') AND e.min_alt_ft IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY floor(e.min_alt_ft / 1000.0) ORDER BY floor(e.min_alt_ft / 1000.0)

SELECT e.heading_sector AS "Richtung", count(*) AS n
FROM overflight_events e
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.entry_ts) AND 
  e.geofence_id IN (SELECT id FROM geofences WHERE name IN ($zone))
  AND e.category IN ($category)
  AND (e.relevant OR '$relevant' = 'alle') AND e.heading_sector IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY e.heading_sector ORDER BY min(array_position(ARRAY['N','NO','O','SO','S','SW','W','NW'], e.heading_sector))

FROM overflight_events e
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.entry_ts) AND 
  e.geofence_id IN (SELECT id FROM geofences WHERE name IN ($zone))
  AND e.category IN ($category)
  AND (e.relevant OR '$relevant' = 'alle')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Anflug/Abflug ist eine Näherung aus Höhenverlauf und Abstand zu BER, keine Verfahrenszuordnung.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.entry_ts AS "Zeit", f.callsign AS "Rufzeichen", f.icao24 AS "ICAO24",
  e.min_alt_ft AS "Höhe ft", round(e.min_dist_m) AS "Abstand m", e.category AS "Kategorie",
  g.name AS "Zone", e.n_positions_inside AS "Positionen",
  round(e.max_position_gap_s) AS "max. Lücke s",
  e.in_reception_gap AS "Empfangslücke", e.flight_id,
  (extract(epoch FROM f.first_ts) * 1000)::bigint AS t_from,
  (extract(epoch FROM f.last_ts) * 1000)::bigint AS t_to
FROM overflight_events e
JOIN flights f ON f.id = e.flight_id
JOIN geofences g ON g.id = e.geofence_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.entry_ts) AND 
  e.geofence_id IN (SELECT id FROM geofences WHERE name IN ($zone))
  AND e.category IN ($category)
  AND (e.relevant OR '$relevant' = 'alle')
ORDER BY e.min_alt_ft NULLS LAST LIMIT 50

WITH ev AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.flight_id FROM overflight_events e
  WHERE $__timeFilter(e.entry_ts) AND 
  e.geofence_id IN (SELECT id FROM geofences WHERE name IN ($zone))
  AND e.category IN ($category)
  AND (e.relevant OR '$relevant' = 'alle')
)
SELECT round(ST_Y(d.geom)::numeric, 3)::float AS latitude,
  round(ST_X(d.geom)::numeric, 3)::float AS longitude, count(*) AS n
FROM flights f JOIN ev ON ev.flight_id = f.id, LATERAL ST_DumpPoints(f.track) d
GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT g.name AS zone, ST_Y(d.geom) AS latitude, ST_X(d.geom) AS longitude
FROM geofences g, LATERAL ST_DumpPoints(g.geom) d
WHERE g.valid_to IS NULL AND g.name IN ($zone)
